How to replace the Google TV home screen

Make Big Screen the home screen

Easiest way: turn on "Home button opens Big Screen" in the Big Screen settings, which opens Android Accessibility, and turn on Big Screen there. The Home button then opens Big Screen.

To replace the Google TV home completely, turn on developer options and network debugging on the TV and run these commands from a computer with adb:

adb connect TV_IP
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith

If the second command says "Unknown package", that device does not have it and nothing else is needed. To bring Google TV back:

adb shell pm enable com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
adb shell pm enable com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith

On Android TV without Google TV, pressing Home usually lets you pick Big Screen directly.
